title: Jordan Sibley
text: Hey! Currently, I am a Master of Environmental Data Science (MEDS) student at the Bren School of Environmental Science & Management. During my time here at Bren, I aim to harness my analytical prowess in data science to drive impactful contributions to scientific research and sustainable solutions for marine coastal ecosystems.

title: Resources
text:
From Data to Viz by Yan Holtz and Conor Healy: A helpful resource for deciding which kind of chart is appropriate for the data you are using
Data Viz Project by Ferdio: Provides a 100 different visualizations from one single dataset





coolors.co: Allows you to generate palettes, extract colors from uploaded images, and a color contrast checker
Viz Palette by Elijah Meeks and Susie Lu: A tool that lets you see your selected colors in different chart types
Colorblind Safe Color Schemes by the NCEAS Science Communication Resource Center: Suggestions for using color schemes that are color blind friendly





Google Fonts: Easy way to view and download fonts, which can be imported into ggplot for use
fontpair: Displays font in a pair that look good together, helpful for selecting heading and body text
Choosing Fonts for Your Data Visualization by Tiffany France: A helpful guide that explains which fonts work best for use in a data visualization





Affinity Designer 2 by Serif: Graphic design and page layout software that is helpful for editing data visualizations and creating infographics
Procreate by Savage Interactive: raster graphics editor app for digital painting on iPad
